title: React v2 Global Aesthetics & Readability: Neon Enterprise Theme & Moving Backgrounds
goal: Overhaul the visual styling and readability of ALL existing React v2 pages to match a 'Neon Enterprise' aesthetic. (1) Introduce a subtle, slowly moving background to the global app shell (e.g., an animated SVG cyber-grid, slow-panning gradient mesh, or faint floating particles) so the app feels alive even when idle. (2) Radically improve readability and typography: increase contrast, improve font weighting (e.g., JetBrains Mono/Inter), and fix dense unreadable data blocks. (3) Apply tasteful neon accents (cyan, amber, red, magenta) to borders, active states, buttons, and hover states with soft CSS glow (box-shadow) effects. It must remain professional (Enterprise) but visibly 'alive' and 'catchy'.
scope: Global CSS, AppShell background, typography, and styling of existing pages (Dashboard, Mission Control, Findings, etc.).
generation_reason: Existing React v2 pages are functional but visually static, hard to read, and lack the requested dynamic/neon 'wow' factor.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus strictly on global layout background, typography, neon glow effects, and CSS enhancements. Do not change data structures or API calls.

success_criteria: App shell features a subtle, continuously moving background effect.
Typography is overhauled for better readability (spacing, weight, contrast).
Interactive elements (buttons, active states) have subtle neon glow effects.
Existing pages (Dashboard, Findings, etc.) look significantly more modern and less like a static spreadsheet.

acceptance_criteria: Builds successfully and global background + typography changes are visible on all pages.
